mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refresh_token (subject_type, user_id, admin_user_id, token_hash, family_id, device_name, expires_at) VALUES (#{subjectType}, #{userId}, #{adminUserId}, #{tokenHash}, #{familyId}, #{deviceName}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, subject_type, user_id, admin_user_id, token_hash, family_id, device_name, expires_at, last_used_at, revoked_at, revoke_reason, created_at FROM refresh_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE refresh_token SET revoked_at = #{revokedAt}, revoke_reason = #{reason}, last_used_at = #{revokedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, subject_type, user_id, admin_user_id, token_hash, family_id, device_name, expires_at, last_used_at, revoked_at, revoke_reason, created_at FROM refresh_token WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > #{now} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
